_comment: F-35 (Aero 481 Design01/A03 provenance) top-level design REQUIREMENTS -- what the aircraft must DO, fidelity-independent. Read the same way as f16a_requirements.json / b777_requirements.json. SCOPE GUARD: requirements only, never spec data (AR, S_ref, thrust, engine model stay in examples/Aero481/inputs/aero481_L1.json) and never discipline-owned quantities (CLmax, CD0, K1, K2, thrust-lapse alpha, TSFC come from the injected Aero481AeroL1 / Aero481PropL1 objects at run time; n_engines from the injected geom/prop object). Full docs + per-field citations + the _TODO roll-up: examples/Aero481/inputs/aero481_requirements.md.
_cite: A481 = University of Michigan AEROSP 481 (Fall 2024) starter code (design PROVENANCE, not primary), docs/reference_extracts/aero481_data.md Part II; Roskam = Roskam Part I; metabook = docs/reference_extracts/metabook_data.md; Mattingly = Mattingly: Aircraft Engine Design 2nd ed.; disc = examples/Aero481/aero481_discrepancies.md (A1-A9). Constraint-class field names verified against src/constraints/*.m fromCondition readers.

constraints._comment: The 12 F-35 constraint conditions mapping each Aero 481 +Constraints/All.m ACTIVE condition to an EXISTING framework ConstraintType (no new constraint class). oei = false throughout (single engine). Each object holds REQUIREMENT / CONDITION data ONLY: CLmax/CD0/K1/K2/CDx come from the injected Aero481AeroL1 object, thrust-lapse alpha and TSFC from the injected Aero481PropL1 object, n_engines from the injected geom/prop object. Condition name -> concrete class is chosen explicitly by Aero481ConstraintSet.constraint_map, mirroring F16ConstraintSet. See aero481_requirements.md sections 2-3.
constraints._cite: A481 = docs/reference_extracts/aero481_data.md Part II; A481 +Constraints/All.m (active constraint list); disc A3/A4/A6.
constraints._note_dropped: DROPPED vs the earlier 20-row set (user decision, A481 parity): (1) the six FAR-25 climb gradients (Climb 1-6 TO/TS/SS/EN/BA/BO) are TRANSPORT-certification gradients, not applicable to a fighter; (2) Takeoff + Landing were framework-only additions -- Aero 481 leaves both UNIMPLEMENTED (All.m:37 sets ConstraintStruct.TO = 0; Landing is a stub). The 12 rows below are exactly the ACTIVE Aero 481 constraints [A481 All.m].
constraints._note_beta: beta = W/W_TO at which the condition must be met -- a SPECIFIED REQUIREMENT INPUT, NOT a mission-analysis output. Cruise / Dash / Ceiling / Sustained-Turn / Instantaneous rows carry beta = 1.0 (takeoff weight -- Aero 481 uses takeoff W/S for these). The six SEP rows carry beta = 0.8285: Aero 481's SpecExcessPower.m ALONE evaluates at the 50%-internal-fuel COMBAT weight W_S_mw = W_S*(1+(1-ff))/2, with ff = 0.343 (the DCA fuel fraction) => (1+(1-0.343))/2 = 0.8285 [A481 SpecExcessPower.m:28]. Setting beta = 0.8285 reproduces that combat-weight basis in the framework Master Equation (beta multiplies W/S in the B/C/D terms). The framework carries the load factor n separately, so beta is the combat fraction only, NOT combat*n.
constraints._note_power_setting: power_setting: fighter 'mil' (0 % AB) or 'AB' (100 % AB), per the A481 condition. Takeoff always evaluates at full AB and carries no power_setting key; Landing is power-off and carries none.
constraints._note_Ps_unit: Ps_fps values are the raw A481 numbers read as ft/s: A481 passes Ps = Ft2M(200) etc., but SpecExcessPower.m uses Ps directly with V in m/s, so the ft value read as ft/s IS the framework value: 200 / 50 / 700 / 400 / 300 / 50 ft/s (SEP1 SL/alt, SEP2 SL/alt, SEP3 SL/alt). _TODO -- UNCITED (student RFP Ps requirement). See aero481_requirements.md section 3.2.

conditions.name: Stall (approach)
conditions._src: StallConstraint -- the W/S wall W/S_max = q_approach*CLmax at the approach state. NOT in Aero 481 (it left Landing/stall unimplemented -> the design space was unbounded on the small-wing side and the min-T/W optimum ran to the sweep edge). ADDED 2026-08-15 (user decision) as the physical small-wing limit so the design sits at a bounded corner. Approach 150 kt at SL = M0.227 (253 ft/s / 1116 ft/s). CLmax = aero.get_CLmax(state) = clean 1.8 [A481 Design01.m:59 CLmax.EN] -> W/S_max = q*1.8 ~ 137 psf. _TODO -- UNCITED: 150 kt is an assumed fighter approach speed (F-35A/C land ~145-160 kt); the framework StallConstraint uses the CLEAN CLmax (conservative clean-config stall wall) -- a flapped-approach wall (CLmax_landing 2.6) would sit higher (~198 psf, less binding).

missions._comment: Mission PROFILES: the ordered segment sequence -- a REQUIREMENT, fidelity-independent. Each segment carries the MINIMUM per-segment inputs: type, end flight condition (alt_ft/mach_end), and whichever of distance_nm / time_min / percent_ab applies. NO discipline-owned data (CLmax, CD0, K1/K2, thrust, TSFC from the injected aero/prop objects) and NO spec data. Every segment yields a fuel burn. See aero481_requirements.md section 5.
missions._cite: dca = [A481 A03.m] DCA (defensive counter-air) mission; aero481_data.md Part II section II.8; Roskam = Roskam Part I Table 2.1 fighter fixed fractions (via MissionEquations.roskam_fixed_fraction); metabook Eq. 2.7 (Breguet range). disc A8.
missions._note_percent_ab: percent_ab: afterburner setting 0-100 (0 = mil/dry, 100 = full AB). Omitted => 0 (dry). Selects/blends the prop TSFC: cT = cT_dry + (percent_ab/100)*(cT_AB - cT_dry).
missions._note_substitution: SUBSTITUTION (disc A8): A03's uncited fixed fractions (ff1 = 0.995, ff2 = 0.99, ff3 = 0.96, ffdescent = 0.98) are REPLACED with the cited Roskam Part I Table 2.1 fighter row (startup/taxi/takeoff 0.990, climb 0.93 [mean of 0.90-0.96], descent 0.990, landing 0.995) via MissionEquations.roskam_fixed_fraction('fighter', ...). Physics segments (cruise-out/dash/CAP/cruise-back) stay Breguet. Landing (0.995) is ADDED (A03 has none; every segment burns fuel). Reserve = 0.05 [A03.m:91].

dca._description: Defensive Counter-Air mission [A481 A03.m]: startup/takeoff/climb (Roskam fighter fixed fractions), cruise-out 300 nmi at 35 kft M0.85, dash 100 nmi at 35 kft M1.6 (full AB), CAP loiter 240 min, combat (2 maneuvers ~= 2x2 min), cruise-back 400 nmi, descent/landing (Roskam fighter). Reserve 0.05.
